title: TSL tally
description: Where the lamps are, which source each one watches, and what colour it shows.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: UDP is what a rack of lamps usually wants. TCP is what a multiviewer or a router usually wants, and it reconnects on its own if the far end restarts.

address.title: Send to
address.description: Where the tally interface is, as address:port. 8900 is the port TSL's own examples use.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: The display group. A rig with one tally interface leaves this at 0 and never thinks about it again.

lamps.title: Lamps
lamps.description: One entry per lamp: which source it watches, its UMD index, and what is written on it. A source with no entry lights nothing.

source.description: Source id, as the mixer knows it.

index.description: UMD index. Defaults to the position in this list.

label.description: What is written on the lamp. Defaults to the source id.

program_colour.title: Programme colour
program_colour.description: What a source on air shows. Red everywhere except the rigs that do not.

preview_colour.title: Preview colour
preview_colour.description: What a source on preview shows.

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: 0 dimmest to 3 brightest. Lamps that ignore it stay at full.

unicode.title: UTF-16 labels
unicode.description: Write labels as UTF-16LE, which a lamp needs for anything outside ASCII. Off halves the packet and is right for an English rig.

refresh_secs.title: Refresh every
refresh_secs.description: Send every lamp again this often, so one that was power cycled catches up without anybody taking a source. 0 turns it off.
